description: Drive straight on the start heading until the camera detector reports a potted plant (object_seen on /camera/detections, score >= 0.5, sighting fresher than 1 s; no distance or bearing, so a plant anywhere in the camera's field of view ends the move, including one already in view at the start), then approach the nearest confirmed potted plant and stop at its default gap. The search move exists because go_to_object aborts with target_not_found when no track is confirmed within acquire_timeout_sec of the second move starting. The gap is resolved at load from gap_min(class) (car front to the object's near edge). Needs semantic_layer_node (/costmap/semantic_tracks) and the global EKF.
